Medical History

- Current health issues and chronic disease risk factors (e.g., hypertension, diabetes):

    - Right-hand paresthesia ("pins and needles").
    - Right arm weakness during episodes.
    - Associated right leg weakness and transient abnormal gait during episodes.
    - Episodes initially ~weekly/monthly, now occurring multiple times per day.
    - Episode duration described as "a few days" (patient later states 3–4 days).
    - Associated symptoms during episodes: fatigue, generalized weakness, intermittent nausea, transient difficulty holding a cup; sensation of "something in my throat" during episodes.
